title: Model usage log entry (per-run)
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL) appended by each daily DCA scheduled task so model routing can be audited over time. Append-only compact log; see config/scheduled_tasks.json -> model_usage_log for the path and policy. This records model routing metadata only and does NOT relax any trading safety rule.

run_id.description: Run identifier, e.g. morning_live_YYYYMMDD_1030ET or scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1530ET. scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET appears only in legacy entries written before the 2026-07-27 retime of 10ce362c.

cron_id.description: Scheduler cron/task id (e.g. 10ce362c). Provide cron_id and/or task_id; at least one must be present.

task_id.description: Manifest task id (may equal cron_id). Provide cron_id and/or task_id; at least one must be present.

scheduled_for_et.description: Scheduled fire time in ET, e.g. 09:35, 09:45, 10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 13:30, 14:30, 15:05, 15:30, 15:35, 15:40. A multi-slot task records the slot that actually fired.

model_requested.description: Model the task requested per policy, e.g. cost_conscious_default or a specific premium model name.

model_actual.description: Actual backend model if the platform exposes it; otherwise the literal 'not_exposed'. When not exposed, still record model_requested and model_routing_mode from the task policy.

reason_for_premium_model.description: Required non-null only when model_routing_mode='premium'. One of the approved reasons: failure_recovery, safety_validation, connector_debug_escalation, explicit_user_request. Null/omitted for cost_conscious/default routing.

artifact_path.description: Path to the run's artifact directory or primary run_state.json.
